caveat: The V8I proxy isolates Columns 503, 504, 505 and 604 at Floor 96 with 3,256 kip. The intact four-face six-floor upper envelope requires 79.5 in, the north-damage-informed case 110.1 in, while an uncapped shell closes at 11.4 in. purpose: Inverse-calibrate a cold core redistribution surrogate to NIST Floor 93-99 total loads and maximum core-column DCR maps, while reserving each floor in turn and twelve declared columns from fitting
caveat: The floor-total logistic surrogate generalizes with 45-kip LOFO MAE and the twelve held-out columns with 0.064 DCR MAE, but held-out Column 804 is underpredicted by 0.331 versus the predeclared 0.30 maximum-error gate. Global mixing also optimizes at its zero boundary. V8N therefore remains an official-output emulator with an unresolved local topology deficit; it is not an independent validation, an event probability, or demolition evidence.

caveat: The vector map folds pass with 68-kip MAE and the cross-figure DCR mean error is 0.059, but the maximum DCR error is 0.359 at Column 705 and Column 804 remains underpredicted by 0.327. The bubble legend also implies about 58,204 kip after impact versus the 34,429-kip tabulated core total, so V8O normalizes relative areas to the table. The single-floor kernel does not validate the multistory cold path and is neither an independent event validation nor demolition evidence.

caveat: The 658 contour states pass all digitization checks: all 23 absent after-impact segments are on officially damaged columns, every Table 4-20 total lies inside the aggregated intervals, and Floor 98 interval coverage against the V8O vector map is 97.9 percent. The smooth vertical graph nevertheless covers only 14.3 percent of 21 untouched intervals, underpredicts the 804 and 605 DCR peaks by 0.653 and 0.795, hits three parameter-grid boundaries, and leaves 101 near-equivalent cases. This establishes non-identifiability of the reduced interpolator, not an independent event contradiction, probability, or demolition inference.

caveat: All seven floor balances are solved exactly, but 79 orthogonal edges plus 24 uncalibrated boundary ports produce 103 flow unknowns, rank 47 and structural nullity 56; every component has null-space support. The six-column blind test covers 40.5 percent of 42 intervals and reaches 505-kip maximum midpoint error, so predictive, transfer-identification and capacity gates fail. Finite bands are minimum-gauge conditioned, not physical bounds; V8Q neither authorizes thermal/Blender coupling nor supports an explosive/thermite inference.

Jointly scaling the optimistic orthogonal prefracture and intact V8M-at-25-in envelopes requires factors 1.94-8.15, controlled by Floor 96. This identifies missing reduced-model capacity and unavailable as-built mapping, not falsified NIST data, event probability, demolition evidence, or authority for thermal/Blender coupling.
